title: One outlier

choices: It can rise a lot: r is sensitive to outliers
r can't be computed with outliers
explanations: Up-right of the center gives a large positive product.
One extreme point can dominate the average of products.

hints: Where is the new point relative to the center?
Both standard units are large and positive.
solution: The outlier's large positive product pulls r up: r is sensitive to outliers.
